What the work actually is

Not a requisition. The product is a control plane, an Executor that runs inside the customer's network, and database engine plugins. People who do well here already care about SQL, trust boundaries, and not overclaiming.

Architecture Trust center

Safer database changes for fast-moving teams. Credentials stay on the Executor you run.
